_comment: The Fabric API module each of Fabricated's own mixins serves (NativeModules), on Forge 47: when another mod provides that module (Forgified Fabric API, a mod bundling its modules), the mixin stands down with Fabricated's part of it. A list names the module under each name it has had; an empty list is a mixin serving no module (loading Fabric mods: registries, fluids, vanilla behaviour Fabric mods rely on), which always applies. A mixin config in a Fabric API package belongs to the module owning the package (the biome, dimension, loot and particle configs; a mixin in a sub-package another module owns goes with that one); configs in Fabricated's packages are listed under configs, or each of their mixins under mixins. The build refuses a mixin missing here.
